description: Enterprise. Clips a raster to your boundary and returns a GeoTIFF download link (30 minutes) with summary stats. product=terrain (default): two bands, elevation in meters and slope in percent (Horn), from USGS 3DEP 1/3 arc-second (about 10 m) where loaded, in the boundary's UTM zone, masked to the boundary plus buffer_m, with acres by slope class (<2, 2-5, 5-8, 8-15, 15+ percent). product=ghi: Global Solar Atlas long-term average GHI in kWh/m2/day at about 250 m. Up to about 150,000 acres per call. Not a survey.

boundary.description: GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon (or a Feature or FeatureCollection of them) in lng/lat, EPSG:4326.

buffer_m.description: Terrain kept outside the boundary, meters, 0 to 2000. Default 100.

parcel_ids.description: Grid parcel ids to use as the boundary instead (merged). Up to 500.

res_m.description: Terrain cell size in meters, 5 to 90. Default 10.

name: terrain_clip
title: Elevation, slope or solar resource raster for a boundary
